Class ExactModel

java.lang.Object
analytical.ExactModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ExactConstants
public class ExactModel extends Object implements ExactConstants
Model data structure of the exact JMVA algorithms: classes, stations, service demands and reference stations of a product form queueing network.

    • generateWhatIfValues

      public double[] generateWhatIfValues(String type, double from, double to, int iterations, int ClassRef, int stationRef)
      This method is used to generate a suitable vector of values for what-if analysis.
      Parameters:
      type - type of what-if analysis to be performed. (WHAT_IF_ARRIVAL, WHAT_IF_CUSTOMERS, WHAT_IF_MIX, WHAT_IF_DEMANDS)
      from - initial value
      to - final value
      iterations - expected number of iterations (will be adjusted to be compliant with specified from and to values in WHAT_IF_CUSTOMERS and WHAT_IF_MIX)
      ClassRef - index of class to be analyzed or -1 for all classes
      stationRef - index of station to be analyzed (only for WHAT_IF_DEMANDS)
      Returns:
      suitable array of iterations to be performed

    • recalculateWhatifValues

      public void recalculateWhatifValues()
      This method will recalculate whatif analysis values after the initial values were changed. At first detects changes, than applies modifications. If what-if analysis is no longer appliable, resets it.

    • checkSaturation

      public int checkSaturation()
      This function will check if one or more resources are in saturation. This will consider each iteration of what-if analysis if present.
      Returns:
      NO_SATURATION if everything is okay, SATURATION if a class saturation is detected with specified parameters and SATURATION_WHATIF if a saturation will be caused by whatif values.
